t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Ṇǀ e Ku-ǂe, ma ǁ‖’ha ka gǁ‖kqon ǀi teː ǀnga ṇdi ǀnga i-ǀga. Ṃa ǁ‖’ha cen kona ǁ‖‘aː teː ǀnga ih ǁ‖‘ha ka kona ǀi teː ǀnga; ṃ ǁ‖’hâ cen ǀa t’hani ǀui teː ǀnga ih ǁ‖’ha ka ǀa t’hani ǁ‖’ali teː ǀnga. Ku-ǂe te’ ṇǁ‖’a ka ǀe ǃ‘an ti, ah’aː kaṇ ǀgu̶bi uhiː, ah’aː ǃngoa ka tam.
